guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul (Joe Perry has a Bone Yard signature) / Brad Whitford Gibson Les Paul
models: Gibson Les Paul (Joe Perry has a Bone Yard signature)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Joe Perry is famously a Gibson Les Paul player (Billie Perry / Boneyard signatures), Brad Whitford also plays Les Pauls.
guitar.notes: Original was reasonable; refined to emphasize Les Paul as primary for both, dropped Strat mention as less central.

tone.target: bright vocal lead with wah and moderate delay
tone.profile: bright vocal lead with wah and moderate delay
tone.summary: A classic Marshall-style chain featuring a boost/overdrive for smooth sustain, followed by a wah effect and an AC30 TB amp model with a bright cab, finished with delay for vocal leads.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide smooth overdrive and sustain for lead lines.
Implement the required wah sweep effect.
blocks.gap: Green OD is used here as a stand-in for a dedicated Wah pedal, focusing on frequency sweeping/filtering.

blocks.purpose: Add grit and bite to the lead tone without heavy fuzz.
Simulate the classic Marshall/British rock sound required for 'Crazy'.
Provide a bright and articulate British cabinet tone.
Enhance upper mids and brightness while avoiding mid-scooping.
Add moderate delay for the vocal lead effect.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall tone clarity for lead work.

proposals.reason: Enhance the articulation of the bright British cab sound.
